verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an OpenAI-compatible public API (api.fireworks.ai) with detailed guides for inference, tool/function calling, structured outputs, batch inference, fine-tuning, and deployment management, all reachable via docs.fireworks.ai and llms.txt. missing for 10: no discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s on all probed paths) and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
